sn35.242:1.1: me sutaṃ || ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kimbilāyaṃ viharati Gaṅgāya nadiyā tire || Addasā kho Bhagavā mahantam dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ || disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi || || Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amum mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan ti Evam bhante || || Vitthāretabbaṃ || pe || || Evaṃ vutte āyasma Kimbilo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kiṃ nu kho bhante orimantīram || || Vitthāretabbo || pe || Katamo ca Kimbila antopūtibhāvo || || Idha Kimbila bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭham āpattim āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānam paññāyati || ayaṃ vuccati Kimbila antopūtibhāvoti || ||
